name: NASA GISTEMP v4 Global Surface Temperature Change
description: GISTEMP v4 (GISS Surface Temperature Analysis Version 4) is NASA Goddard Institute for Space Studies' authoritative estimate of global surface temperature change from 1880 to the present. The analysis integrates in-situ surface air temperature measurements from thousands of meteorological stations in the NOAA Global Historical Climatology Network (GHCN-Daily / GHCNv4) with sea surface temperature (SST) records from NOAA ERSSTv5. GISTEMP computes anomalies relative to the 1951–1980 base period on a 2°x2° global grid using a 1,200-kilometer spatial correlation weighting algorithm, providing a primary climate change benchmark used in IPCC assessments.
